description: This file defines the 'InputMethodSettingsImpl' class, a package-private class implementing 'InputMethodSettingsInterface', responsible for managing and displaying input method settings in Android, including initialization, preference handling, and subtype management.

classes.name: InputMethodSettingsImpl
classes.description: Implements input method settings UI logic, including initializing preferences, managing subtypes, and updating UI elements.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes input method settings, adds preference to the provided PreferenceScreen if the device has multiple subtypes.

methods.name: getMyImi
methods.description: Retrieves the InputMethodInfo corresponding to the current app package.

methods.name: getEnabledSubtypesLabel
methods.description: Constructs a comma-separated label of enabled subtypes for the current input method.

methods.name: setInputMethodSettingsCategoryTitle
methods.description: Sets the title resource ID for the input method settings category.

methods.name: setInputMethodSettingsCategoryTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the input method settings category as a CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerTitle
methods.description: Sets the title resource ID for the subtype enabler.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the subtype enabler as a CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon resource ID for the subtype enabler.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon Drawable for the subtype enabler.

methods.name: updateSubtypeEnabler
methods.description: Updates the preference UI element for subtype enabler, including title, summary, and icon.
